summary: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an Extraordinary General Meeting held July 28, 2026. Shareholders approved a new compensation policy for directors and officers for three years, and approved an employment agreement with new President and CEO Dr. Chen Lichtenstein. Quorum was met with 38.05% of outstanding shares represented. No financial terms, advisor, or premium were disclosed. This is a routine governance event signaling an orderly CEO appointment, not an activist or strategic change. Watch for any future strategic shifts under new leadership, but no risk-arb angle exists.
